title: Unifying Conservation as Translation for General Calculi
summary: We present an abstract framework for conservation and translation theorems between logical calculi. Unlike previous approaches, our setting does not require the underlying consequence relations to satisfy structural properties such as cut, allowing in particular for cut-free calculi. Moreover, we study translations between arbitrary calculi rather than only from a stable extension to the original calculus.
